scope: Installed Codex macOS client: shipped-artifact reconstruction and editable source implementation
excluded: reproduction of OpenAI signing identities or hosted authorization
copying credentials, cookies, tokens, profiles, or user conversation data into reconstructed app artifacts

runtimeReconstruction.method: REA shipped JavaScript/Electron artifact reconstruction; original renderer/assets retained locally
limits: Retained original code is measured separately from editable implementation completeness
Ad-hoc signing cannot reproduce DeviceCheck, APNs or shared Keychain entitlements
Original codex:// OS handler is retained; replica updater is disabled
Runtime interaction and visual parity require independent verification
Local ad-hoc signing does not retain the production hardened-runtime flag; ASAR integrity and all original fuses remain enabled as shipped
Custom desktop --profile uses a second validated native/browser root under Library/Application Support/Codex Replica Local
Standalone helper signatures are preserved; the locally signed main runtime has no OpenAI Team identity, so native app-tools/Computer Use authorization still rejects it.
